description: Use this tool to publish (or re-version) the canonical passport of ONE product that ALREADY has a twin in your organisation; for new products use publish_product_passports, and for a preview that stores nothing use draft_dpp_document. A valid GTIN is required. Returns its real UPI, content hash, version, environment and separate provisional/official validation states. It never submits to the EU Registry or claims certification. Requires dpp:write or legacy create scope.

granularity.description: Passport level: model (one passport per product, default), batch (per lot) or item (per serialised unit).

gtin.description: GTIN-8/12/13/14 of the product; required to publish the passport and to build a GS1 Digital Link.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string for this request; repeating it returns the first result instead of creating a duplicate.

product_id.description: Cycle id of the product (twin) returned by create_product_twin or publish_product_passports. Give this or sku.

serial.description: Serial number of one physical unit (max 20 characters); use with granularity=item.

sku.description: Your SKU of a product that already exists in Cycle. Give this or product_id.

name: create_dpp
